brief.subject: EUDR Brief: November system training and a compliance reality check
brief.headline: EUDR Brief: Commission sets November system training as industry readiness is examined
brief.dek: The Commission flags November training for the EUDR Information System, while new reporting looks at how commodity sectors are preparing to comply.
brief.lede: The European Commission has announced November training dates for the EUDR Information System, the platform for due-diligence filings. Operators who will file should prepare now.

sections.heading: Information System training set for November
bullets: The Commission has published November training dates for the EUDR Information System.
The system is the gateway for submitting due-diligence statements, so filing teams should prepare before enforcement.
Exact session dates were not given in this update; check the Commission's official channels.

sections.heading: How industries are really preparing
bullets: Mongabay has launched a special issue examining how companies are moving toward EUDR compliance and where they fall short.
Coverage spans Brazilian soy traders, Ghanaian cocoa firms and Southeast Asian palm oil farmers.
The focus is traceability, the core challenge for exporters and cooperatives facing the rule after repeated delays.

sections.heading: EU forest and habitat snapshot
bullets: EU forest cover has stabilised at approximately 39% of total land, per the Commission.
Also, 26.4% of EU land is protected, yet 81% of protected habitats have poor or bad conservation status.
These figures frame the EU's environmental case behind its deforestation rules.

sections.heading: Commissioner joins EUDR event
bullets: The Commission reports that a Commissioner attended an EUDR event.
No policy announcements or guidance changes were disclosed in the notice.

brief.seo_description: EUDR update: Commission sets November Information System training, plus reporting on soy, cocoa and palm oil compliance readiness.
